source.name: Magic box
source.description: Packs an ally piece, at the beginning of next round, transforms it into a randon new piece of the same Level and Rank. 12 times available.
notes: Packed piece can be transformed into any piece of the same cost, despite the chess pool limit.
Packed pieces will not transform into pieces you packed into before.

descriptions.en: Packs an ally piece, at the beginning of next round, transforms it into a randon new piece of the same Level and Rank. 12 times available.
descriptions.ru: Упаковывает союзную фигуру, и в начале следующего раунда превращает её в случайную фигуру того же уровня и ранга. Доступно 12 зарядов.
